name: @holepunchto/bare-probe
description: Internal (unpublished) L1+L2 engine behind @holepunchto/bare-network-inspect. core/ = ring buffer, correlator, sampler, batch flusher, ingestion sink, central redactor; clock/ = hybrid logical clock + offset/skew estimation for the multi-peer timeline; adapters/ = transport taps (WebRTC, WebSocket, Hyperswarm); transport/ = length-prefixed framing + per-transport capability contract. Consumed by relative import, not from a registry.
